title: Crisis (TV series)
premise_summary: Crisis is an American action thriller drama television series created by Rand Ravich for 20th Century Fox Television. It aired on NBC as part of the 2013–14 United States network television schedule and the mid-season entry. The series stars Dermot Mulroney, Rachael Taylor, Lance Gross, James Lafferty, Max Martini, Michael Beach, Stevie Lynn Jones, Halston Sage, Max Schneider, Joshua Erenberg, and Gillian Anderson.
